info.title: jeeves-runner
info.description: HTTP API of the jeeves-runner service: the routes in its endpoint catalog (RUNNER_CATALOG). The API has no authentication and binds to all interfaces (0.0.0.0) by default: restrict `host` or firewall the port.

get.description: Get runner service health, version, and uptime.
Query runner running configuration. Optional JSONPath filter.

post.description: Apply a config patch to the running runner service.

replace.description: Replace the whole config instead of merging

timeout_seconds.description: Kill the job after this many seconds.

on_success.description: Slack channel ID for success alerts.

output_channel.description: Slack channel ID for stdout relay.

env.description: Environment variables for script-type jobs. Record<string, string> spread into spawn env alongside JR_* vars. Ignored for session jobs.

args.description: Arguments for script-type jobs. String array appended after the script path in spawn. Ignored for session jobs.

patch.description: Partial update of job config; omitted fields stay unchanged. Schedule changes on jeeves-scripts launcher jobs revert on the next sync-jobs (the manifest schedule is authoritative); change those in jeeves-scripts.json instead.
